The maximum value of this expression occurs when $x = 999$, which gives us $y = 999$ as well.

grade.gold_answer: Let the two integers be $x$ and $1998-x$. The product which needs to be maximized is $1998x-x^2$. Completing the square results in $-(x-999)^2+999^2$. Since $-(x-999)^2\le 0$, the expression is maximized when $x=999$, which results in a value of $999^2=\boxed{998001}$.
